analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see. RSI at 35.1 entering oversold territory, MACD histogram at -195.2247 continuing to worsen. Weekly RSI at 34.0 in weak territory, -26.13% below weekly SMA20. ADX at 29.5 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (36.6) is stronger than +DI (19.0). Current price of 73,140 KRW is near the swing support of 72,105 KRW. With volatility ATR at 4,529 KRW (6.19%), a 1.3x ATR stop loss (5,888 KRW) would set the stop at 67,252 KRW, and a 2x ATR target (9,058 KRW) would set the target at 82,198 KRW. Risk/reward ratio is 1.54, but weak trend reversal signals warrant caution.
